sources.title: 12 principles / character animation mechanics
sources.takeaway: Squash & stretch with volume, anticipation, follow-through, slow in/out, arcs, exaggeration; walk-cycle contact/down/passing/up poses.

sources.title: Animate a 3D model in Blender step by step
sources.takeaway: Keyframing + Bezier easing in the Graph Editor; edge loops around joints for clean deformation.

sources.title: Blender character animation tutorial
sources.takeaway: Apply transforms, origin at the feet, fit the metarig to joints, IK for planted feet, key rig controls, enable Motion Paths to inspect real arcs.

sources.title: Rigify / weight painting / Graph Editor smoothing
sources.takeaway: Metarig, auto-normalized weights, smooth F-curves, refine the torso first.

sources.title: Root motion best practice
sources.takeaway: Avoid stacking Bezier transforms on the root; animate root with care, prefer hips/IK for contact.

sources.title: Blender Python animation (keyframes, F-curves, armatures, IK)
sources.takeaway: keyframe_insert, BEZIER/EASE_IN_OUT, CYCLES/NOISE modifiers, edit_bones, IK constraint, blender --background --python.

sources.title: Blender Python API: Object Operators / Motion Paths
Blender Python API: SceneEEVEE
sources.takeaway: taa_render_samples 64-128, motion_blur_steps, soft shadows / ray tracing for quality.

sources.title: Blender Render Automation (5.0 media_type / FFMPEG)
sources.takeaway: Set image_settings.media_type='VIDEO' before file_format='FFMPEG'; MPEG4+H264; Cycles CPU is reliable headless.

sources.title: Eevee render quality guide
sources.takeaway: 64-128 samples for final, TAA, high bitdepth, soft shadows, bloom, DOF f/1.4-2.8, motion blur shutter 0.5.

sources.title: Bake Motion Path to curve
sources.takeaway: Sample matrix_world per frame and bake a visible Bezier/POLY curve to inspect trajectories.
